*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: synthesize_ssml.py
+import os
+import requests
+
+
+ELEVENLABS_API_URL = "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech"
+
+
+def synthesize_ssml(ssml: str, voice_id: str, output_path: str, model_id: str = "eleven_multilingual_v2") -> None:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("ELEVENLABS_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is required")
+
+    url = f"{ELEVENLABS_API_URL}/{voice_id}"
+    headers = {
+        "xi-api-key": api_key,
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        "Accept": "audio/mpeg",
+    }
+    payload = {
+        "text": ssml,
+        "model_id": model_id,
+        "voice_settings": {
+            "stability": 0.5,
+            "similarity_boost": 0.75,
+            "style": 0.0,
+            "use_speaker_boost": True,
+        },
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=120)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+
+    with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
+        f.write(response.content)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 4:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: synthesize_ssml.py <ssml> <voice_id> <output_path>")
+
+    synthesize_ssml(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+

+    response = client.audio.speech.create(model=model, voice=voice, input=text)

+
+

+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+    audio = synthesize_text(sys.argv[1])

+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
